:::{#def-outcome}
#### Outcome

The **outcome** $\Outvar$ of a data point is the random variable whose value a [prediction](#def-prediction) tries to guess.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-outcome}
#### The outcome in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor, the outcome $\Outvar$ takes the values $0$ and $2$ when the input is $0$, and the values $4$ and $6$ when the input is $1$.

:::
